data.name: Deepshika
data.gender_notes: Deepshika is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Deepshika is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Deep' which means deep like the ocean and 'Shikha' which means radiant. This name signifies a woman who is as deep and mysterious as the ocean, and as radiant and captivating as the sun. The name Deepshika carries the meaning “Deep like the ocean, radiant” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Deepshika usually hope their child will grow to embody deep like the ocean, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes inner depth and outer radiance.
data.etymology: Deepshika belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Deep like the ocean, radiant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Deepshika total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: The name Deepshika embodies the rich cultural heritage of India. It reinforces the value of depth and wisdom, as well as the beauty and radiance of a woman, which are deeply rooted concepts in Indian society.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hinduism, the ocean and sun are considered sacred symbols of creation and divine intervention. Deepshika's name reflects these spiritual principles, reminding us of the deep and mysterious nature of the universe and the radiant and captivating power of the divine. It also encourages a deep introspection, inviting us to explore the depths of our own inner selves, and aims to bring forth the radiance of our true selves.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Deepshika: Radiant and Auspicious Seeker of Truth. The name Deepshika is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Deep' meaning 'ocean of knowledge' and 'Shika' meaning 'arrow'. This name represents the pursuit of knowledge and truth with unwavering determination and focus, like an arrow piercing through the deepest depths of the ocean.

historical_references.reference: Deepshika was a famous Indian actress of the 1960s and 1970s, who acted in several Hindi films. She was born on 23 March 1941 and her acting career spanned over two decades.
Deepshika was also the name of a queen of the Chalukya empire in the Deccan region of India during the 11th century. She was known for her beauty and was the wife of King Vijayaditya.
